question: How does the full teacher-generated DSL pipeline compare with native GEPA when public starting information, proposer and solver models, and model-call ceilings are shared?
prior_exposure: Development task family, descriptions, and some task outcomes were used historically. This is not fresh algorithm confirmation or new-domain transfer.
teacher_seed_schedule: Common base seed; Full preserves the original base-plus-repair-round schedule, GEPA reflection uses the base seed. Actual seeds are retained per request.
decoding: Unconstrained text for students and GEPA reflection. Full DSL teacher uses the original JSON program response schema. Thinking disabled; no hosted fallback or transport retries. Native GEPA proposal-format retries are charged to its four-call parent ceiling.

information.both_methods: Public task description, requirements, labels, schema and the same 54 labeled public cases are available. Algorithms may consume different subsets and feedback schedules.
information.full_probes: Obligations computed from the generated teacher program; expected outputs taken from the shared public case labels.
information.gepa_seed: Public task text and schema, without rendered oracle program.
information.privacy: All teacher/editor and solver calls use installed local models. No private queries or local feedback are transmitted remotely.

full.verification_gate: Exact agreement with all 54 public labels; otherwise deploy the public Raw prompt and retain the failure.
full.representation_search: Original certified_search, 3 representation candidates plus initial 27-case build evaluation; normally at most 108 solver calls.
full.protected_regression_qualification: The unchanged original selector chooses its best edited representation if all edited candidates regress; zero is not a strict guarantee and the canonical seed is not always retained.

gepa.train_and_validation: same 54 public cases; this is optimizer validation, not final evaluation
gepa.editable_space: Unrestricted natural-language instruction text, including public examples, within the common 1800-word bound.
gepa.budget_stop: Reserve complete evaluation batches and stop before an iteration that cannot fit. If native proposal-format retries exhaust the parent ceiling, recover the official GEPAResult from its consistent fully validated native state. Retain best fully scored candidate and every consumed attempt; report unused allowance, incomplete proposals and actual edits.

direct_teacher_dsl: Execute only Full's public-verified teacher-generated program. If unavailable, mark all control predictions invalid; never substitute the reference oracle.
order: For every task/model cell prepare both algorithms, alternating algorithm order by task/model index. Persist all prepared artifacts and a global hash lock before opening ANY final evaluation. Final arm order is fixed and alternated across cells.
scoring: Shared original label normalizer; valid uncertain is None for predictions and reference labels. Invalid, backend-failed, empty or truncated outputs are not valid abstentions and count wrong.
primary_analysis: Per-model mean of the 8 paired task accuracy differences Full minus GEPA. Show every task, each arm's accuracy and failures, task wins/ties/losses, family means and descriptive paired task bootstrap 95% interval (10000 resamples, seed 20261005). Do not treat 216 events as independent tasks or pool model outputs as independent replication.
cost_analysis: Actual attempted/completed/failed solver and teacher calls, observed tokens and summed model latency, end-to-end preparation and final wall time. Full routing is additional computation; do not claim equal actual tokens, time, or total compute.

stop_rules.teacher_backend_failure: Stop; retain partial evidence, do not hide as a compilation failure or rerun for favorable results.
stop_rules.student_backend_failure_fraction: If more than 5% of attempted student calls have backend errors, stop before the next cell; truncations remain scored algorithm failures and are reported separately.
stop_rules.resume: Automatic resumption is not implemented. An interruption retains its complete partial evidence; do not repeat completed final calls or change prompts after final opening. Any new study requires a separately frozen protocol and explicit accounting of the predecessor.

claim_limits: This comparison tests the original pipeline with a matched local teacher and public information boundary; it is not a literal reproduction of the historical 70B-teacher result.
The compiler's finite-domain renderer may enumerate input states using its own learned program; this does not expose held-out reference labels.
Equal available public information and call ceilings do not imply equal realized expenditure or identical prompt spaces.
Neither winning this development panel nor implementing native GEPA establishes algorithmic novelty or publication readiness.
